questions.title: Who can put the ball back on the ground?
questions.question: If you ask a friend to pick up and mark your golf ball, who is allowed to put it back on the spot?

choices.text: Only you, the owner of the ball
Only your friend who picked up the ball
You or your friend who picked up the ball

questions.explanation: You or the friend who picked up your ball can put it back where it was. Both are allowed.

vocabulary.simpleMeaning: To put something small (like a coin or marker) behind your ball so you know where it was.
The exact place where your ball was before it got moved.

questions.teachingTip: Let children mark and replace each other's balls in practice, so they know both the player and helper can do it.
likelyMisconceptions: Children might think only the person who owns the ball is allowed to put it back.
Children might think anyone in the group can put the ball back.

questions.title: Who can put the ball back?
questions.question: If you ask another player to mark and lift your ball for you, who is allowed to put the ball back on its spot afterwards?

choices.text: Only the player whose ball it is
Only the person who marked and picked up the ball
Either the player or the person who picked it up

questions.explanation: Either the person who marked and lifted the ball or the player themselves can put the ball back on its spot.
